about.title: About us

We investigate real needs and propose implementation ready technical architectures, prioritizing agility over bureaucracy

cta.title: How long are we going to wait for a piece of paper
cta.paragraph: In Haiti, being born, voting, or starting a business are just three examples from an endless list of procedures trapped in manual paperwork. While the world moves in seconds, here we're still waiting months for a passport, begging for favors to open a business, or struggling even to get a birth certificate. Absolutely everything works this way
cta.highlight: Technology is not a luxury, it is the end of bureaucratic humiliation
